name: km-personal-tax-domicile
description: Comoros personal tax domicile reference linking the new 2026 definition to the earlier income-tax framework. Sets out the permanent-home and economic-interests alternatives, identifies the unresolved relationship with the older broader residence tests, and distinguishes domestic domicile from treaty allocation. Describes the baseline arrival and departure provisions with explicit amendment-review limits and points to new tax-clearance requirements for permanent departure. Does not invent a day-count safe harbour or certify historic rate tables as current. Full intervening amendments, treaty applications, numerical liability calculations and independent accountant review remain outstanding.
